key_insight: LLM agents can translate natural-language home energy preferences into reliable multi-appliance schedules and achieve near-MILP-optimal cost savings when connected to live pricing, weather, and generation data.
engineering_relevance: This shows a practical path to agentic home energy management that can improve adoption of demand-response and solar-aware scheduling without requiring users to write technical constraints.
method: Tool-calling ReAct agent with live Octopus Agile prices, weather forecasts, PV estimates, and household usage data
Retrieval-augmented knowledge base plus mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) ground truth for comparison
Benchmarked GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 on tariff, conflict, solar, and week-long scenarios
evidence_signal: Across benchmark scenarios, native function calling yielded 100% scheduling success and agents captured 96.7-98.0% of oracle savings over a simulated week.
watch_item: Reliability drops sharply when actions are text-parsed instead of natively function-called, so deployment should prioritize robust tool interfaces and constraint handling.
paper_title: LLMs for Agentic Home Energy Management
